ROBBERY_FAKE_MERCHANT.title: Shifty Shop
ROBBERY_FAKE_MERCHANT.pages.INITIAL.desc:
Two merchants share a crowded rug. One holds up a [gold]Relic[/gold]. The other [sine][purple]moulds a counterfeit[/purple][/sine] to match.

“Guaranteed genuine!”
“Twice your money back!”

They are busy applauding each other. Their wares and coin purse lie at the edge of the rug.
ROBBERY_FAKE_MERCHANT.pages.INITIAL.opti: Fight [red]2 Fake Merchants[/red]. Obtain [blue]{TrueRelicsCount}[/blue] random [gold]Relics[/gold] on victory.
ROBBERY_FAKE_MERCHANT.pages.TAKERELICS.d:
You pocket a few pieces. The edges are soft. The weight is wrong.

[red][jitter]“My wares!”
“Our wares!”[/jitter][/red]

You slip away while they settle the matter.
ROBBERY_FAKE_MERCHANT.pages.TAKEGOLDS.de:
You hook the purse. Both merchants turn at the sound of coins.

[red][jitter]“Weren't you watching the money?”
“I was watching you!”[/jitter][/red]

You leave the counterfeit shop with genuine gold.
ROBBERY_FAKE_MERCHANT.pages.BEGINFIGHT.d:
You place the original beside the counterfeit.

One merchant pushes the shelf behind him. The other blocks the exit.

[red][jitter]“Friend, let's not ruin our good name.”[/jitter][/red]
ROBBERY_FAKE_MERCHANT.pages.TAKETRUERELI:
Both merchants are gone. Counterfeits litter the floor, soft as underbaked dough.

The [gold]genuine Relics[/gold] they copied are still on the table, untouched.
THINGS_BACKROOMS.title: Stumble
THINGS_BACKROOMS.pages.INITIAL.descripti: The uneven stone path winds into the dark. Your boot catches on a raised stone. [jitter]THUD![/jitter] No ground rises to meet you. When you open your eyes, rows of humming lights stretch overhead. Yellowed walls repeat in every direction, each corner leading to another just like it. There are no windows. There is no end in sight.
THINGS_BACKROOMS.pages.INITIAL.options.S: Lose [red]{HpLoss}[/red] HP. [blue]{SearchChance}%[/blue] chance to find the exit.
THINGS_BACKROOMS.pages.SEARCH_FAIL.descr: Corridor folds into corridor. The lights [gold][jitter]HUM[/jitter][/gold] overhead, yet your shadow always falls the same way. You scratch a mark into the wall. Around the next corner, the mark is already waiting. [red][sine]This place is learning you.[/sine][/red]
THINGS_BACKROOMS.pages.SEARCH_FAIL.optio: Lose [red]{HpLoss}[/red] HP. [blue]{SearchChance}%[/blue] chance to find the exit.
THINGS_BACKROOMS.pages.EXIT.description: At last, the wallpaper splits ahead, revealing a pale opening. Cold seeps from its left edge, and the cards at your side grow strangely light. From the right comes the sound of warm water. Straight ahead, you can almost smell the stone road. You have been here long enough.
You step into the gloom. Pale light seeps between your cards. Ink and paper [purple][sine]scatter into the air[/sine][/purple], then settle into unfamiliar shapes. On your next blink, your boots are back on the uneven stone road. The wall behind you is seamless.
THINGS_BACKROOMS.pages.TAKE_ALMOND_WATER: You follow the sound of water into the opening. A cold bottle strikes your palm. You close your hand around it. The next instant drops you back onto the stone road, clutching water far too clear to be trusted. The label reads only: [gold]ALMOND[/gold].
THINGS_BACKROOMS.pages.REST.description: You sit against the wall, meaning to close your eyes for only a moment. The hum of the lights stretches thin and distant. When you wake, you are lying in the middle of the stone road. Your wounds have eased, but somewhere inside you feels [purple][sine]smaller[/sine][/purple]. You decide not to dwell on it.
THINGS_BACKROOMS.pages.LEAVE.description: You shut your eyes and leap straight into the pale void. Weightlessness. You hit the stone road hard. Behind you stands only a cold, unbroken wall. Good enough.
THINGS_MEDUSA.title: Medusa
THINGS_MEDUSA.pages.INITIAL.description:
You enter a gallery lined with statues. Every stone face wears the same surprised expression.

At the far end, a snake-haired woman is untangling one of her snakes.
“Eyes on the floor. Good.”
She slides an empty dish toward you.
“Now we can talk prices.”
THINGS_MEDUSA.pages.RETURN_TO_OWNER.desc:
You set the [gold]Petrified Toad[/gold] in the dish. Every snake on her shoulders turns toward it.

“There you are.”
She plucks a lock of hair and drops it into your palm.
“Keep it. And mind the knots.”
THINGS_MEDUSA.pages.OFFER_GOLD.descripti:
You put the coins in the dish and hand her your chosen card. She presses a finger to its corner.

The paper stiffens like stone.
“That should keep it from wandering off.”
You pocket the card. The dish is already empty.
THINGS_MEDUSA.pages.GREET.description:
You give her a nod and leave the dish alone.

After a moment, she sighs and hands you a little bottle. The bottle, its stopper, even its bubbles are made of stone.
“A gift. Keep it away from your teeth.”
CUTTING_IT_CLOSE.title: Cutting It Close
CUTTING_IT_CLOSE.pages.INITIAL.descripti:
The flagstone beneath your foot sinks.

[jitter]CLACK![/jitter]
A sawblade rolls around the bend ahead and comes straight for you. Its teeth scrape the stones, scattering sparks.

Walls on both sides. You reach for your cards...
CUTTING_IT_CLOSE.pages.INITIAL.options.I: Remove an [gold]Attack[/gold] card. Add [blue]2[/blue] copies [gold]Enchanted[/gold] with [purple]{Enchantment}[/purple] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
CUTTING_IT_CLOSE.pages.IMPROVISE.selecti: Choose an Attack card to split.
CUTTING_IT_CLOSE.pages.ABORTED.descripti:
Before you can draw the card, the blade grazes your clothes and rolls past.

You stay against the wall until you can't hear it anymore.
CUTTING_IT_CLOSE.pages.IMPROVISE.descrip:
You hold a card up to the teeth.

[jitter]RRRIP![/jitter]
Two scraps drift to your feet. When you pick them up, each has become a complete card. They feel much lighter.

The blade rolls on. You count your fingers. All there.
CUTTING_IT_CLOSE.pages.THROW.description:
You throw a card into the teeth. Paper winds around the axle. The blade hops twice and stops at your feet.

You step carefully over it. It clatters again. You hurry on.
REALITY_ALIGNED_HOUSES.title: Reality Aligned Houses
REALITY_ALIGNED_HOUSES.pages.INITIAL.des:
The steps simply end. Grass stretches beneath an impossibly clean blue sky. Identical white houses line both sides of a road that runs beyond sight.

After a while, you pass the same blue mailbox. Not even the edges of the clouds have moved.

Inside is a letter in your handwriting:
[gold]“Welcome back. We kept a house for you.”[/gold]
REALITY_ALIGNED_HOUSES.pages.INITIAL.opt: Duplicate [blue]{Cards}[/blue] card in your deck. Become [red]Cursed[/red] — [gold]{Curse}[/gold].
Lose [red]{HpLoss}[/red] HP. Remove [blue]{Cards}[/blue] card from your deck.
Take the Blue House's Back Door
REALITY_ALIGNED_HOUSES.pages.HOME.descri:
A card waits on the table. Even its creases match the one you chose.

You pocket it. Every chair in the house turns toward you.

Water drips beyond the door. You hurry through. The extra card weighs almost nothing. [purple]The thought of staying weighs much more.[/purple]
REALITY_ALIGNED_HOUSES.pages.ALIGN.descr:
You push the crooked frame into place.

The whole street clicks. Something is [red][jitter]squeezed out of you[/jitter][/red].

When the pain passes, a card is missing. What was it? You try to remember. Your teeth begin to ache again.

Never mind.
REALITY_ALIGNED_HOUSES.pages.BLUE.descri:
A little dish waits behind the blue door, holding [gold]change[/gold] set aside for you.

You pocket it and take the back door. The cave resumes dripping.
REALITY_ALIGNED_HOUSES.pages.ABORTED.des:
You stop. The plaque goes blank, and the houses slide back into place.

The blue house's back door is still open. For now, having no address will do.
REALITY_ALIGNED_HOUSES.pages.DEATH.descr:
At last, you no longer have to walk.

Another white house appears on the horizon.
REALITY_ALIGNED_HOUSES.pages.INITIAL.opt: Merge [blue]2[/blue] unupgraded, unenchanted copies into [green]1[/green] upgraded card.
Requires two matching, removable, unupgraded, unenchanted cards that can be upgraded.
Lose [red]{AddressMaxHpLoss}[/red] Max HP. Upgrade [blue]1[/blue] card and Enchant it with [purple]{Enchantment}[/purple].
Requires an upgradable card that can receive [purple]{Enchantment}[/purple].
Lose [red]{RoadHpLoss}[/red] HP. Gain [gold]{Gold}[/gold] Gold. You may keep walking.
REALITY_ALIGNED_HOUSES.roadHint.title: The Road Without End
REALITY_ALIGNED_HOUSES.roadHint.descript: The HP cost and Gold double each lap. Walk up to [blue]{MaximumLaps}[/blue] laps. You may leave after any lap.
REALITY_ALIGNED_HOUSES.pages.MERGE.keepP: Choose the card to keep and upgrade.
REALITY_ALIGNED_HOUSES.pages.MERGE.foldP: Choose a matching card to fold away.
REALITY_ALIGNED_HOUSES.pages.MERGE.descr:
You take two identical door handles and pull them together.

The houses close like pages. No crash. Just a crisp [gold]click[/gold].

Your deck is thinner. The remaining card feels heavier. Looking down the road, you cannot tell which house is missing.
REALITY_ALIGNED_HOUSES.pages.ADDRESS.sel: Choose a card to upgrade and Enchant with Perfect Fit.
REALITY_ALIGNED_HOUSES.pages.ADDRESS.des:
You write your name on the blank plaque. The pen slows, as though drawing its ink from somewhere inside you.

A chair scrapes against the floor. Someone has sat down for you.

You shuffle your cards. That one returns to the top. At last, it [gold]knows its way home[/gold].
REALITY_ALIGNED_HOUSES.pages.LAP_1.descr:
You walk and walk. The sun does not move.

The blue mailbox returns. Inside is another letter addressed to you, its envelope full of coins.

[gold]“Well done. A little farther next time.”[/gold]

Still your handwriting.
REALITY_ALIGNED_HOUSES.pages.LAP_2.descr:
The houses, lawns, and clouds fall perfectly back into place. Only your legs have changed. They hurt more.

The envelope is thicker.

This letter is short: [gold]“One more lap. Then you'll be home.”[/gold]
REALITY_ALIGNED_HOUSES.pages.ROAD_STOP.d:
You pocket the envelope and head for the blue house.

Behind you, the mailbox clicks shut.

You do not turn around. Some money can stay unearned.
REALITY_ALIGNED_HOUSES.pages.ROAD_END.de:
On the third lap, only one envelope remains.

A figure is approaching along the distant road. It carries your pack.

You take the coins and hurry through the blue house's back door. The sky is still blue. You have seen enough of it.
SHADOW_CLOAKROOM.title: Shadow Cloakroom
SHADOW_CLOAKROOM.pages.INITIAL.descripti:
A cloakroom is tucked into the cavern wall. Your shadow is already at the counter, tapping its fingers impatiently.

The clerk looks up from a row of empty hooks and slides you a claim ticket.

"One card. [gold]{Gold}[/gold] Gold. Back before the big door. We will give it a little... [gold]attention[/gold]."
SHADOW_CLOAKROOM.pages.INITIAL.options.D: Pay [gold]{Gold} Gold[/gold]. Store [blue]{Cards}[/blue] card. It returns [green]Upgraded[/green] before this Act's Boss.
SHADOW_CLOAKROOM.pages.INITIAL.options.A: You have already collected a claim ticket.
SHADOW_CLOAKROOM.selectionPrompt: Store a card. It returns Upgraded before this Act's Boss.
SHADOW_CLOAKROOM.pages.DEPOSITED.descrip:
The clerk takes the card by one corner and gives it a shake. It unfolds into a thin black coat, which goes on a hook behind the counter.

"You won't lose it?"

The clerk glances at your feet.

"Your shadow knows the way."

You pocket the ticket. Your shadow seems a little lighter on the way out.
SHADOW_CLOAKROOM.pages.LEAVE.description:
You beckon your shadow away. It taps the counter twice more before reluctantly settling beneath your feet.

The clerk puts the ticket away.

"Next time, arrive together."
SHADOW_CLOAKROOM.pages.ABORTED.descripti:
You draw your hand back.

The clerk does not hurry you, simply turning the empty hook toward the next customer. Your shadow sighs.
ECHOING_WELL.title: Echoing Well
ECHOING_WELL.pages.INITIAL.description:
You drop a stone down the well.

First comes the sound of a sword being drawn. The splash arrives some time later.

Two tiny jellyfish press their feelers against the rim. A little bottle trembles beside them, waiting for you to say something else.
ECHOING_WELL.pages.INITIAL.options.RECOR: Remove [blue]1[/blue] non-X-cost Attack or Skill. Obtain [gold]Bottled Echo[/gold].
ECHOING_WELL.pages.INITIAL.options.LOCKE: No eligible card, or you already own Bottled Echo.
ECHOING_WELL.selectionPrompt: Remove a non-X-cost Attack or Skill to bottle its echo.
ECHOING_WELL.pages.RECORDED.description:
The card vanishes into the well without a splash. From below comes the sound of the next time you would have used it.

You catch the sound in the bottle. As the cork settles, it taps [gold]three times[/gold].

The original card is gone.
ECHOING_WELL.pages.LEAVE.description:
You leave the bottle alone.

A few steps later, footsteps follow behind you.

One beat late.
ECHOING_WELL.pages.ABORTED.description:
You pull your hand back.

A small, hesitant sound rises from the well. The jellyfish keep waiting.
POLITE_MAW.title: Polite Maw
POLITE_MAW.pages.INITIAL.description:
The mouth spreads its napkin and pushes [gold]a potion and some coins[/gold] toward you, watching your deck.

[green]“Could you spare something to eat?”[/green]
POLITE_MAW.pages.INITIAL.options.MAIN.de: Trade an Attack for a potion, or a Skill for Gold.
POLITE_MAW.pages.INITIAL.options.SPECIAL: Trade a Power for a [gold]Relic[/gold], or feed it a [red]Curse[/red].
POLITE_MAW.pages.MAIN.description:
The maw taps the menu with the tip of its tongue.

"Something crunchy gets a bottle of red. Something soft gets change."

It polishes the little plate once more and waits.
POLITE_MAW.pages.MAIN.options.ATTACK.des: {IsMultiplayer:Each player removes|Remove} [blue]1[/blue] Attack and {IsMultiplayer:receives|receive} an [gold]Attack Potion[/gold].
POLITE_MAW.pages.MAIN.options.ATTACK_LOC: {IsMultiplayer:Every living player needs a removable Attack.|No removable Attacks.}
POLITE_MAW.pages.MAIN.options.SKILL_LOCK: {IsMultiplayer:Every living player needs a removable Skill.|No removable Skills.}
POLITE_MAW.pages.MAIN.options.BACK.title: Keep Looking
POLITE_MAW.pages.SPECIAL.description:
The maw spits out a [gold]Relic[/gold] and wipes it with the napkin.

[green]“This, for something tastier.”[/green]

It pauses, then adds: [red]“Nothing bitter.”[/red]
POLITE_MAW.pages.SPECIAL.options.POWER_L: {IsMultiplayer:Every living player needs a removable Power.|You have no removable Powers.}
POLITE_MAW.pages.SPECIAL.options.CURSE.d: Remove [blue]1[/blue] [red]Curse[/red]{IsMultiplayer: each, if able|}. [red]{IsMultiplayer:Everyone fights|Fight} the Maw![/red]
POLITE_MAW.pages.SPECIAL.options.CURSE_L: {IsMultiplayer:No player has a removable Curse.|You have no removable Curses.}
POLITE_MAW.selection.CURSE: Choose a Curse to remove. A fight follows.
POLITE_MAW.pages.ATTACK.description:
The maw [jitter]crunches[/jitter] through the card and slides you the [gold]potion[/gold].

[green]“Much obliged!”[/green]

You decide to wipe the bottle first.
POLITE_MAW.pages.SKILL.description:
It swallows the card in one gulp. A burp follows, along with a small pile of [gold]coins[/gold].

You pocket the money. It seems pleased with the deal, too.
POLITE_MAW.pages.POWER.description:
The maw swallows the card, closes its eyes, and savors it.

You take [gold]{Relic}[/gold]. It is too distracted to say goodbye.
POLITE_MAW.pages.LEAVE.description:
You shake your head. The maw sighs, but still waves its tongue at you.

[green]“Safe travels.”[/green]
POLITE_MAW.pages.ABORTED.description:
You put the card away.

The maw looks at the empty plate, then at you. You decide to leave quickly.
{IsMultiplayer:Each player removes|Remove} [blue]1[/blue] Attack. {IsMultiplayer:Each receives|Obtain} an [gold]Attack Potion[/gold].
POLITE_MAW.pages.INITIAL.options.ATTACK_: {IsMultiplayer:Every living player needs a removable Attack.|You have no removable Attacks.}
POLITE_MAW.pages.INITIAL.options.SKILL_L: {IsMultiplayer:Every living player needs a removable Skill.|You have no removable Skills.}
POLITE_MAW.pages.TIP.description:
The maw slides over a few [gold]coins[/gold].

[green]“Thank you for not stepping on me.”[/green]

You accept. It has a point.
POLITE_MAW.pages.INITIAL.options.POWER_L: {IsMultiplayer:Every living player needs a removable Power.|You have no removable Powers.}
POLITE_MAW.pages.INITIAL.options.CURSE.d: Remove [blue]1[/blue] [red]Curse[/red]{IsMultiplayer: each, if able|}. [red]{IsMultiplayer:Everyone fights|Fight} the Maw![/red]
POLITE_MAW.pages.INITIAL.options.CURSE_L: {IsMultiplayer:No player has a removable Curse.|You have no removable Curses.}
SHADOW_CLOAKROOM.pages.COINS.description:
Your shadow fishes a few [gold]coins[/gold] out of a crack in the counter. The clerk makes no objection.

[green]“Finally. Someone claimed them.”[/green]
ECHOING_WELL.pages.COINS.description:
You collect a few [gold]coins[/gold] from the rim.

A clear voice thanks the well.

You had not spoken yet.
MYCELIAL_BANK.title: Mycelial Bank
MYCELIAL_BANK.pages.INITIAL.description:
Two mushrooms block the path. The thin one holds a ledger; the stout one hugs a jar of [red]red seeds[/red]. A thick root joins them.

[green]“Life is easily lost if you carry it around.”[/green] The thin one opens the book.

The stout one hides the jar behind its back. It looks good at keeping things.
MYCELIAL_BANK.pages.INITIAL.options.SHOR: Lose [red]{HpLoss}[/red] HP. Heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP after each of the next [blue]{Payments}[/blue] combats.
Requires more than [red]{HpLoss}[/red] HP and no previous deposit.
MYCELIAL_BANK.pages.INITIAL.options.LONG: Lose [red]{MaxHpCost}[/red] Max HP. Gain [green]{MaxHpReturn}[/green] Max HP after defeating this Act's Boss.
Requires more than [red]{MaxHpCost}[/red] Max HP and no previous deposit.
MYCELIAL_BANK.pages.SHORT.description:
Fine roots curl around your wrist. You feel tired. A few more [red]seeds[/red] appear in the jar.

The thin mushroom stamps a leaf.

[green]“Three installments. The roots will find you.”[/green]
MYCELIAL_BANK.pages.LONG.description:
A thick root draws something from your palm. The stout mushroom's cap swells a little wider.

[green]“Past the big door. Principal and interest.”[/green]

The thin one hands you the receipt and slaps its partner's hand away from the jar.
MYCELIAL_BANK.pages.GIFT.description:
The stout mushroom presses a handful of [gold]coins[/gold] into your hand.

[green]“A welcome gift!”[/green]

The thin one crosses out a line in the ledger and gives it a hard look.
MYCELIAL_BANK.pages.DEATH.description:
Everything goes dark.

The thin mushroom stops writing. The stout one hugs the jar tighter.
UNLIT_FIRE.title: The Unlit Fire
UNLIT_FIRE.pages.INITIAL.description:
The logs have not caught, but the ashes are warm. Sand climbs upward through an hourglass.

A wooden sign reads: [gold]“Open yesterday.”[/gold]

You hold out a hand. Warmth from a fire farther ahead has arrived early.
UNLIT_FIRE.pages.INITIAL.options.REST.de: Rest now. Heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP. You [red]cannot act[/red] at your next Rest Site.
UNLIT_FIRE.pages.INITIAL.options.REST_LO: Rest unavailable, no camp ahead, or you already have an Ember Pact.
UNLIT_FIRE.pages.INITIAL.options.SMITH.d: [green]Smith[/green] now. You [red]cannot act[/red] at your next Rest Site.
UNLIT_FIRE.pages.INITIAL.options.SMITH_L: Smith unavailable, no camp ahead, or you already have an Ember Pact.
UNLIT_FIRE.pages.INITIAL.options.FUEL.de: Pay [blue]{Gold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold]. Heal an extra [green]{BonusHeal}[/green] HP on arrival at your next Rest Site.
UNLIT_FIRE.pages.INITIAL.options.FUEL_LO: Requires [blue]{Gold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold], a camp ahead, and no existing pact.
UNLIT_FIRE.pages.REST.description:
You sit beside the cold logs and soon fall asleep in their warmth.

When you wake, the hourglass is empty.

You dimly remember feeling cold the next time you came here.
UNLIT_FIRE.pages.SMITH.description:
The fire never catches, but the edges of your card glow.

You put it away. Far off, something softly goes out.
UNLIT_FIRE.pages.FUEL.description:
You tuck the coins beneath the sign and bring over a bundle of dry wood.

The sand finally begins to fall downward.

Somewhere ahead, a warmer fire waits for you.
UNLIT_FIRE.pages.CHARCOAL.description:
[gold]Coins[/gold] glint beneath the ashes. You brush them clean and pocket them.

Apparently, someone has already paid.
RELIC_WORKSHOP.title: Relic Workshop
RELIC_WORKSHOP.pages.INITIAL.description:
You follow the sound of hammering to a small stall. A beetle in goggles is bandaging a [gold]relic[/gold] that has snapped in half.

“Do not throw it out! Trade it in! Sell it!”

He pats the bulging [gold]purse[/gold] beside him.
RELIC_WORKSHOP.pages.INITIAL.options.NO_: No Common Relic is available for exchange.
RELIC_WORKSHOP.pages.SELECT_TRADE.descri:
The beetle clears a little space on the table.

“Let us see what you have.”
RELIC_WORKSHOP.pages.SELECT_SELL.descrip:
The beetle empties a heap of [gold]coins[/gold] onto the table and beckons toward your pack.

“Which one are you tired of?”
RELIC_WORKSHOP.pages.TRADED.description:
The beetle takes your old relic and [gold]coins[/gold], then slides the replacement across the table.

“Good eye! I just finished fixing that one.”

You carefully put it in your pack.
RELIC_WORKSHOP.pages.SOLD.description:
The beetle snatches up the relic and presses a [gold]purse[/gold] into your hands.

“Just what I needed!”

You have barely left when you hear him taking it apart.
RELIC_WORKSHOP.pages.COINS.description:
You wedge a stone under the wobbling table leg.

The beetle stops working and stares at it for a moment, then hands you a few [gold]coins[/gold].

“That works.”
POTION_TASTING.title: Potion Tasting
POTION_TASTING.pages.INITIAL.description:
A strange, sweet smell leads you to a potion stall. A newt in an apron stirs a bubbling pot beside several [gold]colorful bottles[/gold].

“One is free! For another, bring coins. Or trade one of yours.”

It points at the bottles on your belt.
POTION_TASTING.pages.CHOOSE_FREE.descrip:
[green]“Pick one.”[/green]

The newt wipes the mouth of each bottle.
POTION_TASTING.pages.CHOOSE_BUY.descript:
The newt nudges the bottles closer.

Choose two, then pay [gold]{Gold} Gold[/gold].
POTION_TASTING.pages.CHOOSE_BARTER.descr:
The newt lines up the three bottles.

[green]“Pick the ones you want. Then show me yours.”[/green]
POTION_TASTING.pages.PAYMENT.description:
The newt puts down its spoon and holds out a hand.

“Let me try yours.”
POTION_TASTING.pages.SAMPLED.description:
The newt grabs a potion from the cupboard, wipes it on its apron, and presses it into your hand.

“Come back soon!”
POTION_TASTING.pages.BOUGHT.description:
You place the [gold]coins[/gold] on the table. The newt fishes two potions out of the cupboard and hands them over.

“Do not mix them. I have not tried that yet.”
POTION_TASTING.pages.BARTERED.descriptio:
The newt takes your potion and holds it beneath its nose.

“Good stuff!”

It puts the bottle away and hands you two others.
NARROW_GATE.title: Narrow Gate
NARROW_GATE.pages.INITIAL.description:
You try to squeeze through a narrow stone door. The gap catches your pack and pulls out a few cards.

The face on the lintel opens its eyes.

“Too much luggage! Leave one.”
NARROW_GATE.pages.INITIAL.options.REROLL: Pay [red]{Gold}[/red] [gold]Gold[/gold] to reroll the cards. Once only.
You have already rerolled the cards.
NARROW_GATE.pages.INITIAL.options.NO_ALT: There are no other eligible cards.
NARROW_GATE.pages.REROLLED.description:
You slip [gold]coins[/gold] into the gap and turn the other way.

The door releases the first cards and catches a different set.

“These will do. Stop squirming!”
NARROW_GATE.pages.REMOVED.description:
You let go of the card. The door swallows it with a click.

“Much better.”

The gap widens just enough for you to squeeze through.
POTION_TASTING.pages.WATER.description:
You shake your head. The newt shrugs and ladles a cup of hot water from beside the pot.

You drink it carefully, grateful for a little warmth.
NARROW_GATE.pages.REST.description:
The door squeezes your pack for a while, but fails to extract anything.

You sit down to rest. By the time you stand, it has fallen asleep and the gap has loosened.
BITING_CHEST.title: Biting Chest
BITING_CHEST.pages.INITIAL.description:
A [gold]chest[/gold] sits half-open in the cave. A relic peeks out from its pile of coins.

You reach toward it. The lid snaps shut with a quiet [red]click[/red] of yellow teeth.

Some coins have spilled onto the floor. A wooden wedge lies beside them.
BITING_CHEST.pages.INITIAL.options.REACH: [blue]{Chance}%[/blue]: Obtain a [gold]Rare Relic[/gold]. [red]{Chance}%[/red]: Lose [red]{BiteDamage}[/red] HP and become [red]Cursed[/red] — [purple]{Curse}[/purple].
BITING_CHEST.pages.INITIAL.options.EMPTY: No Relics of this rarity remain.
BITING_CHEST.pages.RELIC.description:
You snatch the relic and pull back before the teeth meet.

The chest sulkily chews a coin.
BITING_CHEST.pages.BITTEN.description:
Your fingers close around the chest's tongue.

It persuades you to let go.
BITING_CHEST.pages.WEDGED.description:
The wedge holds the lid open. The chest finds another angle and bites you anyway.

At least you leave with something.
BITING_CHEST.pages.COINS.description:
You pocket the coins on the floor.

The chest waits a moment, then slowly opens its mouth again.
CROWDED_WARD.title: Crowded Ward
CROWDED_WARD.pages.INITIAL.description:
Every bed in the cave is occupied. A snail with lenses balanced on its eyestalks sticks bandages onto several bulging blankets.

It pats the only empty [gold]stretcher[/gold] with a tentacle.

“Room for one more. Do not touch the bottles.”
CROWDED_WARD.pages.INITIAL.options.ANEST: Heal [green]{LocalHeal}[/green] HP. Draw [red]{Cards}[/red] fewer cards on the first turn of your next [red]{Combats}[/red] combats.
CROWDED_WARD.pages.TREATED.description:
The snail wraps you from top to bottom and gives you a mouthful of bitter medicine.

You stretch. The wounds are closed. One spot still aches.
CROWDED_WARD.pages.ANESTHETIZED.descript:
The pain fades. Your fingers seem to have gone with it.

The snail hands you a folded [gold]chart[/gold].

“It will wear off.”
CROWDED_WARD.pages.BANDAGES.description:
You take a few rolls of bandages. The snail is already moving to the next bed.

Something grumbles beneath the blanket.
CUTTING_IT_CLOSE.pages.INITIAL.options.I: You have no Attack cards that can be split.
